Package org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.integration.dcat

package org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.integration.dcat
Support for the W3C Data Catalog Vocabulary (DCAT) version 3 (https://www.w3.org/TR/vocab-dcat-3/), the standard used by governments and other organizations to exchange descriptions of their data assets. The properties package holds the beans for the resources that DCAT describes, the jsonld package reads the JSON-LD serialization of a DCAT document and the mapping package converts between the beans and open metadata. DCAT documents are exchanged between integration connectors through the integration context in the same way as open lineage events and Bitol documents.

  • Class
    Description
    DcatDocumentFormatter
    DcatDocumentFormatter reads and writes DCAT documents.
    DcatDocumentListener
    DcatDocumentListener is the interface that an integration connector implements and registers with the integration context in order to receive the DCAT documents that are published to the integration daemon.
    DcatDocumentManager
    DcatDocumentManager distributes DCAT documents to the integration connectors that have registered a listener.
    DcatVocabulary
    DcatVocabulary defines the IRIs of the classes and properties from the W3C Data Catalog Vocabulary (DCAT) version 3, and the vocabularies that it reuses, that are understood by Egeria.
